name: doubted-security-check-gap

finding.title: The executable check compares extensions case-sensitively, so `setup.EXE` passes
finding.description: `str.endswith` is case-sensitive, so `setup.EXE` or `run.Bat` passes `validate_upload`, and Windows runs those names as programs. `download_file` in `files/views.py` serves each stored upload to other users under the name it was uploaded with, so a user can share the kind of file the new check exists to stop.

prDiff:
diff --git a/files/uploads.py b/files/uploads.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/files/uploads.py
+++ b/files/uploads.py
@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
 from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
 from .settings import MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
+
+BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS = (".exe", ".bat", ".cmd", ".msi")
 
 
 def validate_upload(upload):
     """Rejects uploads that other users could run when they download them."""
     if upload.size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
         raise ValidationError("File too large.")
+    if upload.name.endswith(BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS):
+        raise ValidationError("Executable files are not allowed.")
     return upload
